title: Rajapattai
desc: A man who aspires to become a villain in films comes to the rescue of an orphanage when a scheming politician wants to buy the orphanage's land and use it for illegal activities.

title: Arai Enn 305-il Kadavul
desc: Two men, who are extremely fed up with their work and non-existent love life, vent their frustration towards God. Affected by their words, God visits them along with a box of power.

title: Bagavathi
desc: Bagavathi, a tea vendor, has big dreams for his younger brother, Guna. However, when Guna's girlfriend's father kills him, Bagavathi must fight to protect Guna's unborn child.

title: Naai Sekar
desc: When his neighbour's experiment goes wrong, Sekar has to bear the consequences as he starts developing the traits and characteristics of a dog.

title: Dharmaprabhu
desc: Yama attempts to save an innocent child and accidentally rescues a corrupt politician along with her. Lord Shiva, who is furious about Yama's mistake, gives him an ultimatum to amend the situation.
